svg.title: Windy's popup with its main shortcuts
svg.desc: Type to search. Enter copies the selected row and Alt+Enter pastes it. Esc clears the search and then closes the popup. Alt+P pins a row. Ctrl plus 1 to 9 picks one of the first nine rows. Clear all needs two clicks. Windy is open source and MIT licensed.
svg.text: Focus starts in the search box.
Pinned rows stay at the top.
